profile.campus: Los Lunas, Valencia County, New Mexico (Meta's Los Lunas data center campus; Data Center Dynamics reported seven buildings on the campus as of 2023, with a further two-building expansion announced)

profile.reading: This Meta data center building (building 1 of 5 mapped in this cluster) is part of Meta's Los Lunas campus in Valencia County, New Mexico, south of Albuquerque. Meta broke ground here in 2016 with an initial $250 million building; a third data center opened in 2020, and Data Center Dynamics reported the campus had grown to seven buildings by 2023, with a two-building, roughly $800 million expansion then under construction, expected to take about three years and intended to support both current products and future AI hardware generations. The Village of Los Lunas has approved industrial revenue bonds to assist the build-out through Meta's Greater Kudu LLC affiliate, part of a financing structure the village has used across multiple expansion phases. On power, Meta and Public Service Company of New Mexico (PNM) marked commercial operation of the Route 66 Solar Facility in July 2022, a 49.5-megawatt, 450-plus-acre solar installation in neighboring Cibola County built by NextEra Energy Resources with more than 150,000 bifacial solar modules, built specifically to help supply renewable power to the Los Lunas data center. Meta's own fact sheet reports more than $2.5 billion invested in the New Mexico campus overall, roughly 400 operational jobs once complete, 1,100 peak skilled-trade construction workers, more than $4.9 million in direct funding to local schools and nonprofits, LEED Gold certification for campus buildings, and a Meta-supported total of 885 megawatts of new renewable energy plus 100 megawatts of battery storage added in New Mexico as part of Meta's global net-zero and 100%-renewable-electricity commitments. Meta does not publish a specific street address, exact building count, or per-building square footage for individual Los Lunas structures; the address above is derived from reverse-geocoding this building's mapped coordinates, not from an operator-published source, and should be treated as approximate.

reading.body:
Meta's Los Lunas campus in Valencia County, New Mexico, does not publish its power capacity. The operator reports $2.5B+ in cumulative investment since groundbreaking in 2016, 400+ operational jobs at full scale, and peak construction of 1,100 skilled trade workers on site. The specific megawatt footprint of the campus itself remains undisclosed, making its scale relative to other AI infrastructure sites impossible to assess from published figures alone.

The campus achieves LEED Gold certification for buildings. Meta reports that electricity use is matched with 100 percent clean and renewable energy and that a Meta-supported project is adding 885 megawatts of new renewable energy and 100 megawatts of battery storage in New Mexico. No published capacity figures exist for any of the 14 mapped facilities in the state, so the contribution of Los Lunas to the state's published AI infrastructure baseline cannot be calculated.

This campus matters to AI infrastructure tracking primarily as a long-term capital commitment by a hyperscale operator in a state with significant renewable energy development underway. Without published power figures, it functions as a known dark node in the continental grid: confirmed built, confirmed operating at scale, confirmed tied to renewable procurement in the region, and wholly absent from any public capacity accounting.
